collection.title: Toyota Mirai 2015 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Toyota Mirai 2015 to 2021 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
